excerpts.label: Early window
excerpts.quote: Gentlemen of the House of Representatives: It is my duty to recommend to your serious consideration those objects which by the Constitution are placed particularly within your sphere - the national debts and taxes.
excerpts.title: November 22, 1797: First Annual Message

excerpts.label: Highest-supported window
excerpts.quote: The revenue received in the present year will not fall short of $27,700,000, and the expenditures for all objects other than the public debt will not exceed $14,700,000.
excerpts.title: December 6, 1831: Third Annual Message to Congress
excerpts.cite: Andrew Jackson, Third Annual Message to Congress, 1831

excerpts.label: Recent window
excerpts.quote: And their conclusion is that the only way to tackle our deficit is to cut excessive spending wherever we find it -- in domestic spending, defense spending, health care spending, and spending through tax breaks and loopholes.
excerpts.title: January 25, 2011: 2011 State of the Union Address
excerpts.cite: Barack Obama, 2011 State of the Union Address, 2011
